module.purpose: Provides clipboard copy, cut, and paste behavior for the tldraw editor, including native events, menu actions, browser Clipboard API integration, external content parsing, file handling, and custom tldraw clipboard serialization.
module.summary: This module coordinates clipboard interactions across browser event and asynchronous Clipboard API paths. It serializes selected editor content into versioned compressed HTML clipboard data, restores tldraw and Excalidraw formats, prioritizes files and embedded content over links and text, supports iframe extraction, and installs React hooks for native and menu-driven copy, cut, and paste actions. It also prevents clipboard shortcuts while editing or when another UI element owns keyboard input.
module.businessContext: This supports copying, cutting, and pasting drawings, files, links, text, and embeds in the collaborative canvas product. Failure causes users to lose clipboard interoperability or prevents content from being transferred between canvases and applications.

postconditions: Native clipboard event handling is installed or updated for the active editor context.
invariants: Clipboard events are handled according to the active editor context and its clipboard options.
edgeCases: When no active editor is available, native clipboard handling does not perform editor operations.
Clipboard events originating from editable or currently edited content are allowed to remain with that content when applicable.
stateMutations: Browser clipboard event listener registration and cleanup associated with the hook lifecycle.
detail.summary: Registers native clipboard event handling for the active editor, covering browser clipboard interactions such as copy, cut, and paste.
